skill.summary: Enables AI agents to reflect on their own reasoning, detect cognitive biases, and improve decision quality through structured self-examination loops.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the skylv-metacognition-engine skill.

- Adds metacognitive abilities for AI agents to reflect on their reasoning and detect cognitive biases.
- Introduces structured self-examination loops with pre-output confidence checks and bias detection.
- Provides a confidence quantification framework to guide responses and clarify uncertainty.
- Supports critical decision-making, bias analysis, and knowledge boundary flagging.
- Includes practical reflection prompts and use cases to improve decision accuracy and agent reliability.
